svg.title: Seven exponential families
svg.desc: Small plots of Bernoulli, Gaussian, categorical, Poisson, exponential, gamma and Dirichlet distributions, each labelled with its sufficient statistic and natural parameter.
svg.text: Seven exponential families (usual parameters, with the natural parameter θ and the statistic T)
Categorical: logits (2, 1, 0). Dirichlet: darker means higher density on the triangle of probability vectors.
